audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags the chart outright: Warwick wins 56.62% over 1277 games but the chart gives Lucian 5 of 7 stages. Row 6 says Lucian while whys[6], spikes[3].text and the late prose all say the matchup flips to Warwick at two items, and the mirror audit already flipped that row to Warwick on its side. Row 0 says Lucian while the packet and whys[0] both put level 1 with Warwick. diff also reads FAV against a 8.5/10 rating and a report line saying 'Hard'.
audit.why: Two layers currently render opposite answers for 2+ items, and a 56.62% lane cannot be Lucian-favoured in five of seven stages.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 6 flipped on both layers as one atomic group with matching ratings; diff set to HARD so it agrees with diffRating, breakdown.difficulty and report[14].

audit.why: The spike shape is right — Lucian owns levels 2 through first item, Warwick's window is two items with Blood Hunt speed. Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 and only 14s at rank 5, and Lightslinger attacks reduce it, which is what makes his disengage feel permanent.
audit.corrected: Windows kept; the 16s number added where the advice needed to be concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and spikes[1].text say he 'dashes out of Infinite Duress range' and that The Culling 'can execute you'. phases[4].why and breakdown.late call Infinite Duress a point-and-click fight starter.
audit.why: Infinite Duress has no meaningful cast range to dash out of — it is a leap in a direction that suppresses the first champion it collides with for 1.5s. What Relentless Pursuit actually does is move him 445 units sideways out of the leap's line. And The Culling carries no execute in Riot's text; it is a torrent of shots, and it is a projectile, so minions and the leap line matter more than a health threshold.
audit.corrected: Restated: the leap is dodged by stepping out of its path, so bait Relentless Pursuit (16s at rank 1) before committing; the invented execute removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged 'Hold Relentless Pursuit' in wants.foe[2] as a probable wrong name.
audit.why: False positive — Relentless Pursuit is Lucian's E.

edits.after: Infinite Duress leaps onto the first champion in its path for 1.5s. He holds Relentless Pursuit (16s at rank 1) to step out of the line — bait it first.

edits.after: Even at 6 Lucian holds the edge — Infinite Duress hits the first champion in its path, so he saves Relentless Pursuit (16s at rank 1) to step sideways out of the line. Bait the dash, then leap.

notes: Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown, so the 16s number is a ceiling, not a promise — I stated it as 'at rank 1' rather than implying a fixed window. Left unverified, matching the mirror auditor: whether the suppression is removed by QSS or Cleanse, and whether Primal Howl's damage reduction applies to the Lightslinger double-shot as one instance or two. Warwick's W range of 4000 in the kit file is the sense range, not a chase range, and no text I wrote leans on it.
